title: fix: increase vitest hook timeout for parallel test imports
body:
CI tests were failing with "Hook timed out in 10000ms" during `beforeAll` hooks that import the renderers module. When multiple test files run concurrently and all initialize the same large module graph, the default 10s timeout is insufficient.

## Changes

- Increased `hookTimeout` to 30s in `vitest.config.mts` to accommodate parallel module initialization

The failing tests (`feedback-overlay-renderers`, `form-renderers`, `layout-data-renderers`) all share the same import pattern:

```typescript
beforeAll(async () => {
  await import('../renderers');
});
```

This import triggers registration of all component renderers across multiple submodules, which takes longer when multiple test files execute simultaneously.
